npcs.name: Trần Khải
npcs.wants_to_say: He commands the defence of Dalian's port and buys fuel from Xiao Beifeng; he feels where a defensive line will break.
npcs.wants_to_hide: He holds the Line System and hides it from Tô Cảnh's institute, which wants all unturned.

npcs.name: Taro Whitman
npcs.wants_to_say: He knows Kisaragi Nam to Khu Đông better than anyone and will sell a safe route or teach scavenging through it.

npcs.name: Tetsuo Price
npcs.wants_to_say: He broadcasts nightly at 22:00 on the ham bands from Nagoya and relays Yoon Ha-eun's Korean broadcasts at 20:00.
npcs.wants_to_hide: He is surrounded and starving in his tower but tells no one, eating once a day.
npcs.source: Tetsuo Price, the Nagoya ham operator

npcs.name: the Observer
npcs.wants_to_say: He wants the Mother for himself.

npcs.name: Captain Daisuke Morgan
npcs.wants_to_say: His company holds the bridges, and his wife and two children are in a refugee block in the Green Zone's park.
npcs.wants_to_hide: He is secretly a hidden unturned with a Command System, hiding it from Lab K and from Langley.

npcs.name: Reina Carter
npcs.wants_to_say: She grew up in her father's garage in Kisaragi Cũ; she watches from the rear on a roof and her rifle can pop a Bloat from afar.
npcs.wants_to_hide: After a bite she gained Null, a zone of biological silence, and hides it from her squad and Captain Morgan.

npcs.name: Lieutenant Mari Ford
npcs.wants_to_say: She wants her mother's family in Itoman on a flight to Hawaii, and she speaks for the bases to the prefecture.

npcs.name: Dr. Takeshi Morrow
npcs.wants_to_say: He pays or asks for sealed tissue samples (Bloater fluid, Lurker throat, Node ridge) and will tell Test Subject 7's weakness only if pressed.
npcs.wants_to_hide: He treats the infection of the Hacker System's holder as a dataset he may slow or steer.

npcs.name: Haruto Quinn
npcs.wants_to_say: He wants the character to live and to stop reporting to Lighthouse.
npcs.wants_to_hide: He is WATCHMAN-7 of Lighthouse and keeps a case holding a sealed sample of the strain in his flat.

npcs.name: Sakura
npcs.wants_to_say: She wants her younger brother Ken alive in Nagoya and to be useful to someone who does not waste her.

npcs.name: Mio Ashford
npcs.wants_to_say: With Dr. Morrow's data she wants a real treatment for the infection, and she wants the Night Nurse gone for the pharmacy stock and basement stair.
npcs.wants_to_hide: She has Stasis, which slows infection at the cost of blue hands for an hour.

npcs.name: Hana Whitlock
npcs.wants_to_say: She wants a project bigger than a single drone and praise from someone who knows good work.
npcs.wants_to_hide: She knows Kazuo was bitten on a vending-machine run and hides it.

npcs.name: Kaede Rowe
npcs.wants_to_say: She leads hunters who capture unturned for the Cordon's bounty; her younger sister Nanako is in the Green Zone's refugee camp.

npcs.name: Reed
npcs.wants_to_say: He carries cable ties for Kaede's hunts and is a hired hand of the K-hunters.

npcs.name: Kang Seo-yeon
npcs.wants_to_say: She works the triage tent at Busan port at dawn and dusk and can read on sight who among the bitten will turn.
npcs.wants_to_hide: She is secretly an unturned hiding inside the system.

npcs.name: Sergeant Ryota Banks
npcs.wants_to_say: He wants his wife and five-year-old son out of Kōtō ward and runs the Rainbow Bridge checkpoint.
npcs.wants_to_hide: He secretly sells crossings through his checkpoint to the Kurogane-kai to pay for a boat.

npcs.name: Jin Archer
npcs.wants_to_say: He is a 19-year-old skater and petty thief from Westbridge; he fears the Cordon's lab.

npcs.name: Colonel Hideki Graves
npcs.wants_to_say: He wants to capture Đối tượng K for the university lab, believing they are a cure or a weapon.
npcs.wants_to_hide: He hides an outbreak in the Camp Harlan field hospital from his ranks.

npcs.name: Tetsu Hargrove
aliases: thủ lĩnh Những Kẻ Bên Lề
npcs.wants_to_say: He asks that a rope be tied at nightfall, knowing the Hive's pull, and for secrecy about the Fringe's tunnels.
